title: Build manager (build queue)
asked: Backfilled from the build queue (done step) (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: The plan's epics as an ordered build queue: drag to reorder, reprocess to restore dependency order, rework flags on built steps whose dependencies changed, a suggested model per step and per feature (Fable 5.1 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5), and two-way status sync with the feature tracker on every consol
